messages:
incident-bot: PAGE 2026-08-04T07:12:02Z - Rapid token-queue growth detected in prod-eu2: /v1/chat p99 latency spike and rerank error rate increasing. Paging oncall @sam.

sam: ACK. I'm on it. pausing noisy alerts and taking the lead.

jess (eng-runtime): traces show a handful of API keys issuing very large contexts (~>6000 tokens) and many parallel streams. chat QPS jumped 4x; embeddings mostly steady, rerank spiking from same keys.

sam: initial containment: apply per-route emergency quotas to stop token starvation and keep embeddings available. will keep rerank aggressively limited.

sam: running emergency commands:
```
rbctl quota set --route "/v1/chat" --scope prod-eu2 --rate 45rpm --burst 30 --reason "emergency-token-pressure"
rbctl quota set --route "/v1/rerank" --scope prod-eu2 --rate 6rpm --burst 3
rbctl quota set --route "/v1/embeddings" --scope prod-eu2 --rate 180rpm --burst 120
rbctl feature toggle --name heavy-rerank --scope prod-eu2 --state off
```

deploy-bot: rbctl: quotas updated for /v1/chat, /v1/rerank, /v1/embeddings by sam

ops-bot: runbook: https://internal/runbooks/queue-backpressure-eu2

lina-cs: I'm seeing inbound tickets from Partner:Alpha and Customer:Vega about timeouts/500s. drafting CS script now. which customers will see throttling vs degraded ranking?

sam: chat will be throttled for the heavy keys; rerank effectively disabled for most tenants in prod-eu2. embeddings left high to avoid cascading failures to similarity features. I'll gather affected-key list.

jess: applying traffic-shaping policy to favor small requests and prioritize embeddings over rerank to keep routing features functioning.

jess: traffic policy applied:
```
policy: small-first-embeds-priority
match:
  - request.token_count <= 256 => priority: high
  - route == "/v1/embeddings" => priority: medium
action: concurrency {high:250, medium:150}
```

sam: within 6 minutes backlog dropped from +4100 tokens to +820 and p95 improved from 5.8s to 2.4s. rerank errors reduced but still noisy.

partner-alpha: noted the throttles. we found a cron that lost backoff and spun up many parallel requests; rolling a fix now. thanks for the quick containment.

sam: adding temporary exceptions for ops/support keys so runbooks/tools still work: `rbctl quota exception add --route "/v1/chat" --keys ops/*,support/* --limit 200rpm --scope prod-eu2`

deploy-bot: exception added for ops/* and support/* on /v1/chat

lina-cs: messaging plan: send a targeted customer alert to top 12 affected accounts and post a short cluster-wide notice in #customer-alerts. prepping templated text.

pm-eric: product note: disabling rerank will impact search relevance for enterprise customers. please include that in CS scripts and prioritize outreach for top revenue customers.

sam: ramp plan: if p95 < 3s and backlog < 300 for two consecutive 10m windows, increase chat +10rpm every 10m, rerank +2rpm per window until baseline. abort and re-throttle if backlog > 1000 or p95 > 4s.

jess: filing follow-ups: ENG-RT-701 implement token-weighted throttling (requests cost ~token_count), ENG-RT-702 add per-route circuit-breakers for rerank, ENG-RT-703 alert tuning for route-specific token queues.

ops-bot: note: temporary limits may affect billing metrics for impacted customers. lina-cs, coordinate with billing on notices.

lina-cs: will include billing impact line and CSA contacts. ETA posting to customers 12m.

sam: @tony-night you'll take the 08:00Z handoff. leaving current state and the exact commands in this thread. backlog currently ~160, p95 1.7s over last 10m.

tony-night: ACK. I'll monitor ramp and be ready to re-open paging if retry storms resume. if backlog > 1200 I will re-pager.

jess: discovered a client sending many >8k token contexts via an older SDK that didn't enforce max_context; filed SDK ticket SDK-48 to add client-side hard caps.

sam: also added short-term allowlist for a small set of staging/QA keys that need higher throughput during incident response. command: `rbctl quota exception add --route /v1/chat --keys qa/* --limit 150rpm --scope prod-eu2`

deploy-bot: exception added for qa/* on /v1/chat

partner-alpha: patch deployed, reducing retries and parallelism. we see traffic normalize, will monitor logs and reduce bursty jobs.

jess: metrics update: backlog 80 tokens, p95 1.3s for last 15m. beginning first ramp +10rpm to chat per plan.

deploy-bot: rbctl: quota update for /v1/chat by sam: +10rpm

incident-bot: UPDATE: backlog < 200 for 20m, p95 < 2s. recommend de-escalate oncall and proceed to postmortem. :white_check_mark:

lina-cs: customers notified. collecting affected-key to customer mapping for postmortem/outreach.

pm-eric: please include an explicit customer-facing remediation recommendation: reduce parallelism, exponential backoff with jitter, cap context size per request, and prefer embeddings for similarity routing where possible.

sam: leaving follow-ups: ENG-RT-701/702/703 and SDK-48. tagging eng-runtime and sdk teams. handing off monitoring to @tony-night.

tony-night: will keep this thread open for postmortem notes and will escalate if we see regressions within 6h. thanks team. :thumbsup:
